title: Judge wording sensitivity report v1
description: The `--output` of `eval judge wording`: how far a judge's verdicts move when its prompt is reworded, measured against the noise floor of re-draws on the same pairs. `judge_temperature` is added by the command.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

summary.description: The judge, the conditions, and the per-variant agreement and fragility.

reports.description: One report per condition, keyed by the condition name.
